name: HYDRA-UMC-GATEWAY-INDUSTRIAL
notes: Functional v0: GET /status makes a real, live reachability check against all 3 children on every request - verified end-to-end, including detecting a real killed sibling. Plus a real command allowlist + backpressure + timeout decision layer (src/command.ts, CommandDispatcher) in front of POST /command: default-deny per-protocol allowlist (only read-like/publish operations allowed in v0), bounded concurrency (no more than maxConcurrent commands in flight, rejected immediately beyond that), and a real timeout - all enforced before any relay attempt, mapped to real HTTP status codes (403/429/504/502). The default executor reuses the existing real reachability probes; an actual protocol-level write is not implemented yet, honestly. src/tls.ts now provides real, opt-in TLS 1.2+/mutual-TLS on this gateway's own HTTP API (TLS_CERT_PATH/TLS_KEY_PATH, optionally TLS_CLIENT_CA_PATH), closing a real gap where the README already advertised mTLS as delivered while the server was actually plain HTTP - verified with a genuine end-to-end mTLS handshake test against real openssl-generated certificates. Evidence is simulator: the test suite runs the Modbus TCP adapter and its write gate end to end against a simulated device, including exception responses and timeouts; no run against a real PLC or meter is recorded.
